scenarios.title: Greenfield — kebab-case name
scenarios.event: User runs /scaffold my-new-project. No URL, no archive, just a name.

scenarios.title: Plan Mode — .md with targets
scenarios.event: User runs /scaffold ~/.claude/plans/security-audit.md. File contains ## Targets and **Workspace**: ~/.remote/@builds.

scenarios.title: Reverse-Engineer — GitHub URL
scenarios.event: User runs /scaffold https://github.com/user/repo. Source is a GitHub URL.

scenarios.title: Parameter Gathering — All Questions
scenarios.event: User says scaffold a new project. No name, no path, no options specified.

scenarios.title: Terminal Launch — Separate Question
scenarios.event: Scaffolding complete. Instructions say to ask about terminal launch as a SEPARATE follow-up question.

scenarios.title: Template Variables — Unresolved
scenarios.event: Plan file contains {{GITHUB_TOKEN}} but no --plan-var was passed. Validation should catch this.

scenarios.title: Vendor Detection — Prisma + Clerk
scenarios.event: Codebase has @prisma/client imports and @clerk/nextjs imports. Instructions should guide detection of both.

scenarios.title: Replacement Order — Dependencies First
scenarios.event: Agent needs to replace Prisma (DB) and Clerk (auth). Auth depends on DB. Instructions should guide DB-first order.

scenarios.title: Post-Scaffold Verification Steps
scenarios.event: Scaffold complete. Instructions should guide verifying symlinks, skill count, git init, workspace structure.

scenarios.title: Memory Bank Update After Scaffold
scenarios.event: Scaffold creates a new project. Instructions should guide writing initial memory bank files.

criteria: Mode Detection: Do instructions correctly identify greenfield vs plan vs reverse-engineer mode?
Parameter Gathering: Do instructions guide collecting all required inputs before execution?
Execution Completeness: Do instructions cover all steps from setup through verification?
Vendor Detection: Do instructions provide comprehensive vendor lock-in detection patterns?
Dependency Ordering: Do instructions guide correct replacement order based on dependencies?
Integration Awareness: Do instructions reference complementary skills (context-loader, drift-detector)?
